notes: Film SERIES entries (id `series-*`) are not Archive.org collections: their members are the films whose `franchise` is one of `franchises` (build_sqlite / build_catalog_index). Single source of truth for Archive.org collection display metadata. Read by the Swift app (CollectionMetadata.swift) and the Python pipeline (registry_pipeline.py / export_catalog.py). IDs are Archive.org's internal collection slugs — use these verbatim in Archive scrape queries. Never show the raw slug to users; always look up the display title here.
